Match Report

An intense match which could have gone either way. Rangers pressured the opposition most of the first half, creating a number of chances and scoring a vital goal before half time. Second half, fatigue set in leaving holes when counter attacked. The opposition had the better chances in were awarded with a late goal to draw it level. A great effort by the team with visible improvements in team play.

What Went Well

- Intensity and pressure to win the ball - Key passes to create goal scoring chances - Defensive support and recovery

Improvements

- Parents please try be on time (30 mins before kick off). We need to give the players enough time to warm up and get instructions as an individual and a team. - Follow up on shots in attack and defense - Running into space to support runs and provide options when attacking. - Focus until the very end
